definition.unit: A completed (closed) trade reported by Robinhood's realized profit-and-loss history.
definition.success: Realized gain greater than zero, after any fees Robinhood includes in that figure.
definition.horizon: None: a trade counts when it closes, however long it was held.
definition.denominator: Every closed trade in the window with a readable realized gain. Trades with an unreadable gain are counted and excluded, not assumed.
definition.open_positions: Open positions are excluded; their unrealized results are shown separately.
definition.not: This is a record of past trades. It is not a probability that a future trade will succeed.

missing: get_pnl_trade_history was not readable in this synthetic build.

definition.unit: A dated Accumulate, Trim or Exit Review call recorded by this page when it was shown.
definition.success: Accumulate: the stock's price return beat the benchmark's over the horizon. Trim / Exit Review: the stock's price return trailed the benchmark's.
definition.horizon: 63 trading days (about three months) after the call date, on closing prices without dividends.
definition.denominator: Every directional call whose horizon has fully elapsed. Hold and no-call entries are not directional and are excluded. Calls whose horizon is still running are counted as pending.
definition.open_positions: Not applicable: outcomes are measured on the price, whether or not the account acted.
definition.not: This measures whether past model calls beat the benchmark. It is not a forecast, and it is separate from the account's own trades.
